stargazing-tickets.important1: The number of spots on our trips is limited - we recommend registering for stargazing trips in advance.
stargazing-tickets.important2: The project is weather-dependent - events may be canceled or rescheduled due to bad weather, so watch for updates.
stargazing-tickets.important3: You'll need to make your own way to the site - unfortunately, we don't provide buses.
stargazing-tickets.important4: Take a close look at the other sections of the site if you still have questions, and be sure to subscribe to our Telegram.

stargazing.program-arrival-desc: Arrive by car an hour or an hour and a half before the start (the time is on your ticket) and take a spot.
stargazing.program-lecture-desc: As dusk falls - an engaging lecture about space on a big screen, about an hour long.
stargazing.program-sky-desc: We learn to spot bright stars and constellations right in the night sky overhead.
stargazing.program-telescope-desc: Several telescopes are aimed at different objects - take a look and ask the astronomers your questions.
stargazing.guide-howto-text: The whole evening step by step: registration, the way to the field, a lecture, a tour of the constellations and telescopes.
stargazing.guide-where-text: Sidewalk astronomy in the streets of Orenburg and trips out of town, where nebulae and galaxies are visible without light pollution.
stargazing.guide-rules-text: What not to do on the field: bright lights, fires, alcohol and noise spoil the observing for everyone.
stargazing.guide-faq-text: How much it costs, what to bring, whether children can come and what if it rains: answers to common questions.
stargazing.hero-lead: An evening out of town: a lecture under the open sky, a walk through the constellations and Saturn's rings in a telescope eyepiece.
stargazing.no-photos: No photos have been uploaded from this event yet. Check back later!
stargazing.title: Stargazing trips
stargazing.seo-title: Stargazing trips in Orenburg — telescope nights
stargazing.description: Stargazing trips near Orenburg: an evening out of town with telescopes, a talk about space and dark skies free of light pollution. Upcoming dates, program, rules and booking.
stargazing.program-lead: From sunset to deep night: four parts of one evening under the stars, 2–4 hours.
stargazing.team-photo-alt: The Look at the Stars team
stargazing.team-text: We are amateur astronomers from Orenburg. Since {{year}} we have been bringing telescopes out of town, giving lectures about space and showing the sky to everyone who wants to see it with their own eyes.
stargazing.team-link: About the project and the team

stargazing-history.title: Stargazing trip archive
stargazing-history.description: Here are all our stargazing trips and sidewalk astronomy evenings: from the first trips out of town to nights that bring together more than a thousand people. Every trip has its own page with photos and videos, the topic of the lecture, the number of participants and reviews from those who were with us under the stars. Browse by year, remember your own nights and choose which trip to go on next.
